2609.35261.title: Imprint Reader: From Weight-Update Readout to Behavioral Intervention
2609.35261.paper_summary: As language models take a growing role in AI development, a natural aspiration is for them to reflect on their own learning process, as humans do, and use that reflection to improve themselves. At the same time, these models have an advantage that human learners lack, since training leaves parameter-level traces that can, in principle, be inspected directly. However, current models cannot decode these traces into an explicit account of what they have learned. To this end, we introduce the \textit{Imprint Reader}, a model trained with \textit{Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning} (SaRT) to describe frozen weight updates. SMaRT mounts each update onto the Reader and uses an anchor-free meta-query to elicit a natural-language description, while no-change and random-perturbation controls discourage unsupported claims. On held-out updates, the joint Reader reaches judge-based Pass@100 of $2\%$ for knowledge and $16\%$ for behavior. These results demonstrate the feasibility of natural-language readout while pointing to reliability across updates as the next step. Beyond free-form generation, the Reader provides a differentiable proxy for the gap between a specified target behavior and a candidate weight update. Its coordinate-aligned gradients support intervention through MetaEdit. At a $0.5\%$ pruning rate, Reader-guided selection raises measured harmful-prompt refusal from $57.9\%$ to $64.1\%$ under a safety-maintenance target. Using behavior descriptions without target-task training data, MetaEdit increases the frequency of backtracking and sub-goal expressions in mathematical reasoning traces and raises BFCL Overall from $41.69\%$ to $44.60\%$.
2609.35261.paper_summary_zh: 隨著語言模型在人工智慧發展中扮演越來越重要的角色，一個自然的願望是讓它們像人類一樣反思自己的學習過程，並利用這種反思來改進自己。與此同時，這些模型擁有一個人類學習者所缺乏的優勢，因為訓練留下了可以直接檢查的參數級痕跡。然而，當前的模型無法將這些痕跡解碼為它們所學習的明確說明。為此，我們介紹了\textit{Imprint Reader}，這是一個通過\textit{Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning} (SaRT)訓練的模型，用於描述凍結的權重更新。SMaRT將每次更新安裝到Reader上，並使用無錨的元查詢來引出自然語言描述，同時無變化和隨機擾動的控制措施則抑制不支持的主張。在保留的更新上，聯合Reader達到了基於評審的Pass@100為知識的$2\%$和行為的$16\%$。這些結果展示了自然語言讀出可行性，同時指出在更新間的可靠性是下一步。除了自由形式生成外，Reader還提供了一個可微分的代理，用於指定目標行為和候選權重更新之間的差距。其坐標對齊的梯度支持通過MetaEdit進行干預。在$0.5\%$的修剪率下，Reader引導的選擇將測得的有害提示拒絕率從$57.9\%$提高到$64.1\%$，以達到安全維護目標。使用不帶目標任務訓練數據的行為描述，MetaEdit增加了數學推理痕跡中回溯和子目標表達的頻率，並將BFCL整體從$41.69\%$提高到$44.60\%$。
